create_BBoxFeature: create a BBoxFeature instance for a normalized bounding box with shape (4,) and float32 dtype
encode_example_BBoxFeature: encode a bounding box example from a BBox tuple or 4-dim numpy array into a float32 tensor
repr_html_BBoxFeature: generate an HTML string representation of a single bounding box as a thumbnail image
repr_html_batch_BBoxFeature: generate an HTML string representation of a batch of bounding boxes as thumbnail images
from_json_content_BBoxFeature: deserialize a BBoxFeature from JSON content or protobuf bounding box feature
